name: MVGS_CS_GENOMIC_TEST_TYPE
title: MV-GenomSeq genomic test type
description: Type of a prior genetic test as delivered by the BfArM Datenkranz (KDK oncology case.priorDiagnostics[].type). Carried on the genomic study (Procedure.code, example binding) so that read length and single-gene tests are kept; the standard method type goes to genomic-study-analysis extension:method-type via mvgs-cm-genomic-test-type-method-type (DISCUSS-TD #12, REPRESENTATIONS #12).

concept.definition: Targeted sequencing of a gene panel.
Analysis of a single gene (method not specified by the Datenkranz); no MII or GR concept exists (DISCUSS-TD #12).
No prior genetic test was performed.
